comment: Launchpad OAuth 2.0 credentials — from your Launchpad OAuth client registration. Never commit this file with real values; credentials.example.json is the checked-in template.
authorize_comment: Cluster frontend authorize URL (uas/oauth/authorize) — different domain than the app server
token_comment: App server OAuth token endpoint, proxied through the dev server on localhost:6006 to avoid CORS
revoke_comment: App server OAuth revoke endpoint, proxied through the dev server
mashupClientSecret_comment: Required when the OAuth client registration is Confidential
redirectUri_comment: Must exactly match the redirect URI registered on the OAuth client
